general.title: Next scheduled council election
general.dateBasis: Calendar calculation from the rule published by ECQ, not an issued notice of election. This indicative date does not activate a countdown.

earlyVoting.status: No Redland 2028 early-voting timetable verified in this first pass. Dates, eligibility, opening hours and locations will be linked when ECQ publishes the election details.

byElection.dateBasis: ECQ announced on 5 November 2026 that the by-election will be held on 12 December by full postal ballot. The countdown is to the start of that Brisbane calendar date, not the opening of polling or a postal deadline.
byElection.status: Full postal by-election on 12 December 2026. Nominations run from 10 November until noon AEST on 19 November. Postal votes must be completed by 6pm AEST on 12 December and received by ECQ by 5pm AEST on 22 December.

nominationDeadline.dateBasis: ECQ’s issued notice and event timetable confirm nominations close at 12pm (noon) on 19 November 2026, Queensland local time (AEST, UTC+10). No opening clock time is stated.

sources.title: Council confirms mayoral vacancy following resignation
sources.publisher: Redland City Council / Redlands Coast Today
sources.supports: Resignation received, vacancy, by-election required, Julie Talty continuing as Acting Mayor.

sources.title: Council to seek full postal vote for Mayoral by-election
sources.publisher: Redland City Council / Redlands Coast Today
sources.supports: Council agreed to request an ECQ recommendation for a full postal ballot, subject to electoral requirements and approvals. No voting method or timetable approval is announced.

sources.title: ECQ election events
sources.supports: No Redland event timetable listed at this check; 2024 local elections held 16 March 2024.

sources.title: Local Government Act 2009, sections 161, 164 and 165
sources.supports: Mayor replacement and acting arrangements; final part begins at third anniversary of previous quadrennial election.

sources.title: Local Government Electoral Act 2011, sections 24, 25 and 27
sources.supports: Ordinary by-election timing, notice and nomination/poll intervals; nominations before noon. This is not an issued election timetable.

sources.title: ECQ local government candidate guidance
sources.supports: Eligibility, training, nomination and campaign obligations; guidance does not announce Redland nominations.

sources.title: Rowanne McKenzie: public intention to nominate for Mayor
sources.publisher: Cr Rowanne McKenzie, public Facebook page
sources.supports: Public decision to nominate for Mayor, not ECQ acceptance.
sources.method: Public cloud-browser post and expanded text; displayed 7 hours ago at 11:20 UTC on 1 November (21:20 AEST), establishing the local calendar date without inventing a precise posting time.

sources.title: Council Division 7 newsletter: official Facebook handle
sources.supports: Council newsletter identifies Cr Rowanne McKenzie and Facebook handle @rowannemckenzie7; used to authenticate the announcement page.

sources.title: ECQ: Redland mayoral by-election date set, 5 November 2026
sources.supports: 12 December 2026 by-election; full postal ballot approved; notice of election and candidate nominations opening on 10 November. No nomination closing or postal deadline is stated.

sources.title: Redland Bayside News: five people report intentions to nominate
sources.publisher: Redland Bayside News / Local News Group QLD
sources.supports: Media-reported intentions to nominate by Julie Talty, Rowanne McKenzie, Don Brown, Gary Williamson and Jasmine Person. Not an ECQ accepted-nomination list; exact original announcement dates are not established for the four additional records.

sources.title: ECQ Redland City Council mayoral by-election timetable
sources.supports: Notice issued 10 November; nominations 10–19 November, closing at noon; election day 12 December; postal completion 6pm 12 December and receipt 5pm 22 December. Queensland local times AEST.

sources.title: Redland City Council Mayoral by-election: Notice of Election
sources.supports: Nominations open 10 November and close at noon on 19 November 2026; full postal by-election on 12 December.

sources.title: ECQ Redland candidate information and certified nominations
sources.supports: Candidate nominations appear after certification by the Returning Officer. Official Redland event details links this search page. Text retrieval exposed no candidate rows, not proof of no certified nominations.

sources.title: ECQ Redland certified-candidate register
sources.supports: The Redland City register displayed Melissa Millar and Gary Williamson, both Independent. The register publishes names after Returning Officer certification. This is a dated snapshot of the open nomination period.

sources.title: Liela D’Rose’s public mayoral candidacy announcement
sources.supports: D’Rose publicly announced on 8 November that she is running with Animal Justice Party endorsement. The 12 November ECQ register did not display her name.

postalVotingProposal.summary: On 29 October, Council agreed to seek a full postal ballot. This earlier request is retained as history; ECQ subsequently confirmed ministerial approval on 5 November.

byElection.candidateCoverage: On 12 November, the ECQ register listed Melissa Millar and Gary Williamson, both Independent. Public intentions and party endorsements appear with their own labels. This is a snapshot during nominations; follow ECQ for later certifications and the final ballot.

nominationsOpen.note: Opening calendar date only; ECQ does not specify an opening clock time.

postalVoting.summary: This is a full postal ballot. ECQ will mail ballot packs after nominations close. Complete the vote by 6pm AEST on 12 December 2026; ECQ must receive it by 5pm AEST on 22 December 2026. These are separate completion and receipt deadlines, not in-person polling hours.
